provenance.status_detail: Legistar status IN COMMITTEE, in control of the Committee on Rules. Only action: introduced and referred 1/30/2025. Checked 2026-11-10.
checks: Owner must live in the house or the ADU and record an affidavit and deed restriction before final occupancy (14-604(11)(e), not changed)
Only one street-facing entrance unless a second already existed (14-604(11)(h), not changed)
ADU must be inside the house or inside a detached accessory building that existed when the 2012 Zoning Code took effect (14-604(11)(c) as amended)
District rules apply only where they limit growth of the structure to no more than 10% (14-604(11)(b) as amended)
Overlay bans in Chapter 14-500 are not changed by the bill
Historic properties also need Historical Commission review (14-604(1)(f))
This bill is pending in committee. It is not law
provenance.notes: Layer on top of philadelphia. Removes the detached or semi-detached test, the RSA-5 or CMX-1 test, the 1,600 sq ft lot test and the 800 sq ft cap. New (b): ADUs are subject only to district rules that limit growth of the structure to no more than 10%.

zoning_districts.note: Any lot occupied by a single-family use. Overlay bars still apply.

building_types.note: Deletes the detached or semi-detached test. Rowhouses qualify.
